mapper.insert: INSERT INTO focus_session (client_id, task_title, note, mode, planned_sec, started_at, ended_at, duration_sec, paused_sec, status, session_date) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{taskTitle}, #{note}, #{mode}, #{plannedSec}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{durationSec}, #{pausedSec}, #{status}, #{sessionDate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM focus_session WHERE client_id = #{clientId} LIMIT 1
SELECT task_title FROM focus_session WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND task_title <> '' GROUP BY task_title ORDER BY MAX(started_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE focus_session SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration_sec), 0) AS totalSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mode = 'countdown' AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pomodoroCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'aborted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS abortedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT session_date) AS activeDays FROM focus_session WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND session_date >= #{from} AND session_date <= #{to}

SELECT session_date AS `date`, COALESCE(SUM(duration_sec), 0) AS totalSec, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mode = 'countdown' AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pomodoroCount FROM focus_session WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND session_date >= #{from} AND session_date <= #{to} GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date ASC
